goal: Complete and verify VII administration, slider control, legacy redirects and Google measurement in the requested order.

intent_model.literal_request: Do items 2, 3, 4 and 5 immediately and in order.
intent_model.implied_outcome: No earlier discussed operational, redirect or measurement capability remains merely present in code; each works and is provable in its real destination.
likely_rejections: A feature is described as done without signed-in persistence or source reconciliation.
A partial historic URL list is called complete.
Tracking code is called connected without owned-property evidence.
A new production release regresses v632.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory and close every affected family for the four named items.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Every family member receives passed evidence, a precise external blocker or justified non-applicability.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Do not begin the next implementation family before the current one reaches its midpoint evidence or exact external dependency.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Evidence is recorded sequentially for admin conversions, sliders, redirects and measurement.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Operators see truthful totals and manageable controls before infrastructure diagnostics.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose one date/family or one setting and see its exact effect.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Drill to source evidence or publish the validated setting.

natural_destination: Authenticated VII administration, public VII routes, historic URLs and owned Google product diagnostics.

facts.claim: Production v632 is the active verified public baseline.
Conversion and slider implementations are ancestors of the v632 source commit.
The currently known legacy corpus contains 3,528 classified source URLs.

assumptions.claim: An authorized signed-in VII administration route remains available.
assumptions.validation: Open the admin route in an authorized session and verify the role without exposing credentials.

assumptions.claim: Adir owns or can access the relevant Google properties and container.
assumptions.validation: Discover connected sessions and exact property/container identity before any mutation.

in_scope: Conversion dashboard reconciliation, filters, drill-down, permissions and persistence
Holiday and slider administration save, reload, public reflection and failure states
All authorized historic URL corpus sources, redirect validation, canonical and sitemap consistency
GA4, Search Console and Tag Manager discovery, connection, consent, event validation and live evidence
Production publication and rollback when the exact candidate passes
out_of_scope: Inventing historic URLs absent from an authorized source
Creating a new Google organization, property or container under an unverified owner
Accessibility and typography audit, per Adir's standing exclusion for this QA program
invariants: Preserve v632 discovery sorting and refresh rotation.
Preserve catalog generation and supplier failure fallbacks.
Do not fabricate conversion, order, availability or tracking data.
Do not redirect unrelated URLs to the homepage.
Do not send personal data to analytics.
Keep HE, EN, FR and RU routes and canonical state intact.
affected_family: VII public homepage availability and holiday sliders
VII public canonical and hreflang family
Owned Google Analytics 4 property and web stream
Owned Google Search Console domain or URL-prefix property
Owned Google Tag Manager web container
All VII public worlds and supported languages

requirements.source: User item 2 and VII data/admin standards

requirements.statement: Slider and holiday administration persists a one-through-six limit and safely controls public behavior.
requirements.source: User item 3 and accepted VII slider decision

requirements.statement: Every authorized historic URL source is classified and redirects directly to an equivalent final route.
requirements.source: User item 4 and VII legacy migration plan

requirements.statement: GA4, Search Console and GTM are connected and verified in their owned natural surfaces, or an exact human-only ownership dependency is proven.
requirements.source: User item 5 and VII measurement standard

requirements.statement: The exact production release preserves v632 and has a tested rollback.

acceptance_checks.setup: Authorized operator and a date/family with source data
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Totals reconcile to the same scoped source rows and distinguish contacts from completed orders.
Authorized role succeeds and unrelated role is denied without data exposure.

acceptance_checks.action: Save a valid holiday count and reload without cache
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The authoritative value persists with save feedback and audit evidence.
Invalid input is blocked and the public slider shows last-good cards or an actionable bounded state.
Each source is direct permanent redirect, intentional live route, gone or explicit unresolved item with no loops or chains.
Missing corpus is recovered or documented as one exact ownership dependency without a false completeness claim.

acceptance_checks.setup: Verified owned Google property/container and consent state
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The event appears exactly once in debug/realtime with approved parameters and no personal data.
Exact owned identities and access levels are known before any change.

acceptance_checks.setup: Frozen candidate after all prior checks
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once and exercise public/admin checks
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Deployment succeeds, exact version is live, v632 invariants pass and rollback identity is preserved.

open_questions.question: Which Google property, stream and GTM container are owned by VII?
open_questions.resolution: Discover connected account state and existing production identifiers before item 5.

open_questions.question: Is a complete historic Search Console or server-log export accessible?
open_questions.resolution: Inspect connected Google services, repository imports and existing authorized exports during item 4.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, verified configuration and one production publication are authorized. No account creation, credential disclosure, destructive global redirect or uncertain duplicate publication is allowed.
